title: David Anointed in Hebron
reflectionText: After David was anointed king in Hebron, his first recorded message carried a blessing to the men of Jabesh Gilead who had buried Saul, and a promise to reward their kindness to their lord. Whose faithful act, quietly done, might call for open thanks from you today?
editorialNotes: Packet 023 initial writer output. Short-only owner plan. The retelling remains within 2 Samuel 2:1-11 and preserves the inquiry, the anointing, the message to Jabesh Gilead, and the rival kingship of Ishbosheth.
